# T-2: Classify preserved final-regression evidence

## Goal
Persist parsed nested records in the existing final-regression raw log and artifact, then derive failure nature and attribution only from preserved typed evidence.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R5 exposes every nested record with a durable attempt-log reference in raw and structured artifacts.
- R6 removes unsupported assertion/existing inference and uses unattributed_unknown_failure conservatively.
- R7 preserves command, lifecycle, config, report, retry, issue-log, and record-and-proceed behavior.
- R8 proves retained-surface behavior parity, artifact/classification behavior, and zero diagnostic reruns.

## Implementation Notes
Let RunFinalRegressionCommand consume the shared marker parser and attach rawOutputPath through dedicated artifact fragment classes. Extend FinalRegressionFailure and recovery policy classes for unknown attribution. Preserve outer process diagnostics and existing pass/skipped paths. Do not add a compatibility reader for old artifacts.

## Test Strategy
Add spec-local command-level fixtures for nested exit, signal, timeout, spawn-error, assertion, silent non-zero, truncation, malformed/absent marker boundaries, artifact validation, and unknown recovery. Preserve shared pass/fail/skipped/retry/status/report/config/issue-log tests and spy on runProcessDetailed plus nested spawn calls to prove unchanged counts.
